# Khun Camp

> Content system for real-estate agent YouTubers who post consistently but have no funnel turning viewers into clients. We build the strategy, production, and conversion layer, then run it monthly.

## Offer
- One package, no tiers — pricing discussed on a call
- For: real-estate agents already posting on YouTube 2x/week or more, with no booking link, lead magnet, or CTA structure between a viewer and a client
- Not for: agents who want virality/views without a sales goal

## Proof
- Founder Shawn Arrington built his own YouTube channel to 60,100 subscribers across 6,900 published videos
- Khun Camp's growth strategist took a channel from 0 to 15,000 subscribers and generated $44,500 from its first product launch
- In-house daily production pod ships content for Khun Camp's own brands
